lines.text: Which drain cleaner actually eats a hair clog?
He drops hair and soap and grease and even tape into every product for twelve hours.
And the clear winner on hair is plain lye.
Because hair is made of protein and lye chops those protein chains apart until the clog dissolves.
Drano and Liquid Plumber tie with it because they're mostly lye too with some bleach.

insert.title: HAIR CLOG (HIS A B C GRADES)

lines.text: The enzyme sticks just turn everything blue because bacteria work slowly over days.
And the acids eat a carrot but also strip the plating off a steel pipe.
So acid works on food clogs but it attacks metal which is why it's only safe for plastic pipes.
Nothing touched the paper towel or tape so for solid stuff a drain snake beats every bottle here.
And never mix them because bleach plus acid makes toxic chlorine gas.
So what's really clogging your drain?
